en: And that's it for this course.
In this course, you now learned a lot about
Codex, about proper prompt and context
engineering,
and about the various features offered by
Codex that allow you to work on your code
with help of this very capable coding
assistant. You learned how to manage your
context, how to construct proper prompts,
how to leverage features like agent skills
and construct feedback loops, We had a look
at the security concept behind Codex and
many, many other things like using Codex in
the cloud, working with worktrees, and much
more.
And therefore, as always, the best way to
apply what you learned is to just use it in
your future projects, no matter if it's real
projects or dummy projects, play around with
it and apply what you learned in this
course.
